title: React Router and Remix
description: Conventions for React Router and Remix.

rules.title: Loaders and actions
rules.text: Fetch data in route loaders and mutate through actions instead of effects.

rules.title: Route error boundaries
rules.text: Define an error boundary for each route segment that can fail.

rules.title: Progressive forms
rules.text: Use Form components so mutations work without client JavaScript.

rules.title: Typed route params
rules.text: Validate and type route params before use.
